seo_title: Hobie Mirage Drive Kayaks | Quest Watersports, Ottawa IL
seo_description: Your Ottawa, IL Hobie kayak dealer: Mirage Drive pedal kayaks, Pro Angler fishing kayaks, Compass, Outback, iTrek and Eclipse. Demo rides near Starved Rock.
body_html:
The world is a water park, and since 1950 Hobie has made the best rides. They have surfed. They have sailed. And to each sport, they have brought flat-out, live-fast, have-fun adventure. That is exactly what you get with every Hobie kayak, plus something brilliantly new to kayaking: pedals.

Quest Watersports is a Hobie dealer in Ottawa, Illinois. Come see Hobie kayaks in our showroom, or demo your favorite model at nearby Heritage Harbor Marina.

Shop Hobie kayaks · Shop Hobie iTrek inflatables · Used and demo kayaks · Kayak parts

How the MirageDrive works

Each Hobie Mirage model has the patented MirageDrive pedaling system. You pedal by stepping alternately left and right, not unlike an exercise stepper, to drive two underwater flippers that work much like a penguin's fins. The result is surprising speed and ease.

  • Easy to use, quiet, and creates no splash
  • Leaves your hands free for fishing, photography or holding a drink
  • Much faster and more efficient than paddling, because the large muscles in your legs produce more power than your arms

Built to glide and keep you dry

Each Hobie kayak is a seamless, roto-molded hull: sturdy, stable and swift. All Hobie kayaks have a closed-deck design with self-draining scuppers and seats to keep you dry. Sure-grip handles fore and aft make them easy to carry, most models offer on-deck paddle storage, and molded-in cup holders are standard.

Popular Hobie models at Quest

Current in-store models include the Mirage Compass, Outback, Passport, Pro Angler 12 and 14 (180 and 360 drives), the Fiesta family kayak, the iTrek inflatables and Eclipse, and the Tandem Island sailing trimaran. See the full collection for current prices and colors.

  • Hobie Mirage Compass: an all-around pedal kayak
  • Hobie Mirage Outback: a stable crossover for fishing and sightseeing
  • Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 and Pro Angler 14 360: the flagship fishing platforms
  • Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 12: a compact, standable fishing kayak
  • Hobie Mirage iTrek Fiesta: an inflatable family pedal kayak
  • Hobie Mirage iTrek Eclipse: a stand-up pedal board

Hobie Mirage Eclipse: stand tall on the water

In summer 2016, Hobie launched the Mirage Eclipse and created a new category of on-water fun by adding pedal-driven agility to the walk-on-water sensation of a surfboard. Stand tall aboard an incredibly stable board and just get on and go using MirageDrive leg power. Carve turns with fingertip steering controls, and go from the car, the dock or your boat to the water in minutes. The board is lightweight and durable, with gear tie-downs and a carefree kick-up rudder. Cruise solo, with your partner, or with a group.
